assays.assay_name: Wet Dog Shakes and Back Muscle Contractions
assays.assay_description: Rats were observed in their home cages (with feeding trays removed and wire lids) for 90 s every 15 min for 2 h after sc injection. The number of WDS and BMC were counted by an experienced rater and totaled across the 8 observation periods. Body temperature was also measured via implanted transponder. Includes dose-response for 5 agonists and antagonism by M100907 pretreatment.

outcomes.summary: All five 5-HT2A/2C agonists (DOI, 25C-NBOMe, 25I-NBOMe, 2C-C, 2C-I) dose-dependently increased wet dog shakes and back muscle contractions in rats. NBOMe compounds were 5- to 20-fold more potent than their 2C counterparts. Pretreatment with the selective 5-HT2A antagonist M100907 (0.1 mg/kg) blocked both behaviors for all agonists, demonstrating 5-HT2A receptor dependence. None of the drugs significantly altered body temperature.
outcomes.evidence: DOI administration markedly increased the frequency of WDS (F5,48 = 14.80, p < 0.0001) and BMC (F5,48 = 27.34, p < 0.0001)... Pretreatment with the selective 5-HT2A antagonist M100907 effectively eradicates both behaviors from all drug groups

judge_notes: All candidates identified a single behavioural assay (WDS + BMC observation). Merged into one assay entry as the same paradigm under different agonists and antagonist pretreatments — per rubric, dose/drug/antagonist variants = 1 assay.

D2 scored 2 (61 min–6 h): although each individual observation epoch was only 90 s, the session of 8 observation periods spans 2 h. Candidates disagreed (0, 1, 2); chose 2 based on total session span as gptoss reasoned.
D4 scored 1: pre-injection baseline observation was conducted (‘Immediately before vehicle or drug injection... animals were observed’).

E7 scored 0 (Alone): paper states ‘Animals were individually-housed post-operatively’ before behavioral experiments, so during the test the focal rat is alone in its cage despite group housing earlier. Overrode gptoss’s ‘Free social group’ interpretation.
Excluded radioligand binding and calcium mobilization assays — these are in vitro molecular assays, not behavioural.
DOI: no statement that this set of weekly injections constitutes ‘repeated dosing’ — each rat received one drug dose per week, with different doses randomized; treating as acute per dose.
